Apply now!Manpower is looking for a Senior Service Technician for a company in Nijmegen.As Senior Service Technician, you will be responsible for:    - Carrying out preventive and corrective maintenance on wind turbines    - Diagnosing and resolving electrical and mechanical faults    - Replacing large components such as generators and gearboxes    - Working strictly according to safety standards and NEN guidelines    - Documenting completed activities and incidents    - Assisting with inspections, retrofit projects and root cause analyses    - Taking part in scheduled weekend and emergency servicesWhat’s in it for you    - Gross monthly salary between € 3,500 and € 4,500, depending on experience    - Direct contract with the employer, with prospect of permanent employment    - Full-time position of 40 hours per week    - Travel expense reimbursement according to company policy    - 25 vacation days and 13 ADV days    - Company van for commuting from home to sites    - Extensive training and recertification opportunities    - Career progression towards specialist or managerial roles    - Regional assignments with limited travel time    - Minimum mbo level 3 or mbo level 4 diploma in Electrical Engineering or similar field, or relevant experience    - At least three years of electrical engineering experience    - Knowledge of hydraulics and or mechanics is an advantage    - NEN 3140 and NEN 3840 certification, or willingness to obtain    - Strong English communication skills due to reporting and safety documentation    - Valid driving license B    - Ability to work at heights and good physical condition    - Independent and solution f

Looking for that full-time job with training and growing opportunities? Work only in the day shift? Look no further! You found your  new job as a warehouse employee at Xenos in Waalwijk!Sign up now and receive a WhatsApp message within 15 minutes with a few short questions so we can help you quickly. Don't have a WhatsApp? Then we'll contact you by phone or email!What we offer- Work in only day shifts- Full-time work- Salary of €14,99 per hour- A friendly and cosy working atmosphere!- Reimbursement of travel expenses- Work in different departmentsWho you areTo keep the warehouse running, it is important that you meet the following requirements as a warehouse employee:- You have your own transport to go to Waalwijk.- You speak Dutch or English.- You can work in day shifts.- You are available 5 days during the week.What will you doSofas, chairs, confetti cannons, candles, cushions... Xenos has it all! As a warehouse employee, you’ll work among all this fun, colorful stuff. You work at the department for all of the products for the Xenos stores. You’re going to be driving around on an EPT to get all the different products! You put everything where it needs to go. You don’t need any prior experience, we’ll teach you everything!This job is for the dayshifts only. You'll work from 07:00h until 16:00h. Awesome, right?!Xenos pays different wages per age:- 18 jaar: €7,50/hour- 19 jaar: €8,99/hour- 20 jaar: €11,99/hour- 21+ jaar: €14,99/hourWhere will you workYou have probably already seen the Xenos stores! They are located all throughout the country! You will recognize Xenos by their fun, yellow logo 💛. Xenos has great products for your home. You will often see them in the warehouse! You will also get a great discount at the Xenos stores!As a warehouse employee you will have great colleagues. You take breaks together and you are well supported by the team leaders. You’ll definitely feel welcome here!Job applicationSounds good right? Apply

Work on the careful processing of technical products at DHL in Eindhoven. As a logistics employee in the Ericsson department, you will be responsible for registering, cleaning, checking and preparing electronic equipment for shipment. In return for your accurate work, you will receive a gross hourly wage of €15.12, shift allowance, travel reimbursement and the opportunity to obtain a contract with DHL. Would you like to work in an environment where quality and precision are key? Apply today.Your responsibilities include:    - Booking and labeling products    - Cleaning products according to the applicable procedures    - Repackaging products    - Collecting orders    - Storing goods in the warehouse    - Checking shipments and preparing shipments for transportWhat’s in it for you    - Gross salary of €15.12 per hour    - 35% shift allowance after 21.00     - Travel reimbursement up to €14.85 per day    - Pension accrual through Manpower    - Temporary employment contract through Manpower with the opportunity to obtain a contract with DHL    - Free access to more than 200 online training courses through the Manpower Academy    - At least 18 years old due to the nature of the work    - Available to work 40 hours per week    - Own transportation to travel to the work location    - Good command of the Dutch and/or English language    - Willingness to perform physical work    - Ability to apply for a Certificate of Conduct (VOG)Are you ready to start working as a logistics employee in Eindhoven at DHL and work with technical products? Don't wait too long. There is currently room for new colleagues, but the number of available positions is limited. Click the apply button and we will contact you as soon as possible.
